question: How did researchers estimate what share of 2024 biomedical abstracts had been written with chatbot help?
options: By running AI-text detectors over them
By counting words used beyond their trend
answer: By counting excess words. Kobak and colleagues projected each word's frequency from its pre-2023 trend, as epidemiologists estimate excess deaths, and measured the overshoot: delves, showcasing and underscores soared. The excess implied more than one in ten 2024 abstracts was processed with a language model. The chatbots gave themselves away through their favourite words.
move: To measure an effect, first forecast what would have happened without it.
trap: Trusting detectors that judge texts one by one and often misfire.
reference: Kobak, González-Márquez, Horvát & Lause, Delving into LLM-assisted writing in biomedical publications through excess vocabulary, Science Advances, 2025
